data.one_liner: Windows 95 UI components and styling for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a complete set of Windows 95 styled UI components like Scaffold95, Button95, Menu95, and TextField95 to give Flutter applications a nostalgic look and feel.
use_when: You want to build a retro Windows 95 styled app or theme in Flutter.
You need ready-to-use vintage UI components like window scaffolds, toolbars, and classic buttons.
avoid_when: Your application requires a modern Material Design or Cupertino interface.
You need standard cross-platform platform-adaptive widgets.
strengths: Provides a coherent, nostalgic Windows 95 aesthetic out of the box.
Includes a rich variety of components like Scaffold95, Menu95, Checkbox95, and Dialogs.
weaknesses: Niche design style that is unsuitable for standard business or consumer applications.
Limited to the components explicitly built into the package.
